tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Find new video games Creative Cult follows, by name. Returns each game's release date, the latest share of player reviews that recommend it with its date, and a link to its page. Games with a slug have a full report you can read with get_game. Leave the query empty to list every game with a report,

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Creative Cult's report on how players received one game: the share of player reviews that recommend it and its date, what players praise and criticise, who the game suits, answers to common questions, and numbered sources. Takes the game's name or its slug from search_games.

tools.name: get_release_calendar
tools.description: Notable video games releasing in a month, with dates from publishers and platform holders, platforms and US price where announced, and for games already out, the share of player reviews that recommend them. Defaults to the current month.

tools.name: get_best_of_month
tools.description: A month's new video games ranked by the share of player reviews that recommend them. A game needs at least 500 reviews to be ranked. Critic scores are never used. Defaults to the latest ranked month.

tools.name: list_research
tools.description: Creative Cult's research pieces: teardowns of how launches landed with players, the monthly Reception Index, and how the firm runs player research. Returns titles, summaries, dates and links.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_games, get_game, get_release_calendar, get_best_of_month · Public sink: search_games, get_game, get_release_calendar, get_best_of_month.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_games, get_game, get_release_calendar, get_best_of_month · Public sink: search_games, get_game, get_release_calendar, get_best_of_month

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
